# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/refberg/SyliusAutopayPlugin/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or pull request for a security problem.

## Supported versions

| Version                 | Supported |
|-------------------------|-----------|
| 1.x (latest release)    | Yes       |
| Older releases          | No        |

The supported Sylius, PHP and Symfony versions are listed in the "Requirements" section of the [README](../README.md#requirements).

## Third-party vulnerabilities

Report vulnerabilities in Sylius to the Sylius project and vulnerabilities in Autopay services to Autopay.
